strings.(언제인지 알 수 없는 데베시스의 과거, 그때의 흐릿한 기억이 흘러 들어: (A hazy memory surfaces from some unknown point in Devesis' past.)
strings.크리드에는 너 같은 녀석도 있구나. 마계에 있는 놈들보다 정신력이 강하네: So Creed has people like you, too. Your will is stronger than that of the creatures in the Demon Realm.
strings.고위 마족을 불러 놓고 부탁을 이렇게밖에 못 하는 거야?: You summon a high-ranking demon, and that is how you ask a favor?
I-I will do as you wish, Lady Belial.
strings.이번에는 특별히 네 영혼을 거두지 않을게. 네가 나타나서 이보다 더 좋을: As a special exception, I won't take your soul this time. Your arrival couldn't have worked out better.
Step into this mirror. Your ancestral god, Ignore, whom you have been waiting for, should be inside.
How fortunate. I was never certain what becomes of someone who kills a god.
strings.네 뜻이 뭔지는 모르겠지만, 너는 오래전에 내가 가둔 네 조상신을 죽이게: Whatever your intentions, you will end up killing the ancestral god I imprisoned long ago. That is how this mirror was made.
Don't tell me you brought me here to...
Hehe. Sadly, I missed it that time. I'll be watching you from here.
strings.괜찮지, 탈로스?: You don't mind, do you, Talos?
strings.셰프님, 나 말하는 거야?: Chef, are you talking about me?
strings.아니요. 뭘 봐서 파텔로 씨가 예쁘다는 거죠?: No. What on earth makes you think I mean you, Patello?
Juriring, the chef says you're beautiful.
I hear you helped us out. Come here whenever you're hungry and put your meal on my tab.
strings.진짜요? 링? 정말 와서 다 먹어도 돼요? 링?: Really? Ring? Can I really come and eat anything I want? Ring?
strings.속고만 살았어?: Has everyone you've ever met lied to you?
Hooray! Three cheers for Patello! Ring!
Now there's someone who understands me.
Juriring, let's go looking for gems in the mine together sometime. It'll be fun.
Oh, I'd love to! Ring! Let's go together. Ring!
strings.쥬리링 소원이 데베시스 마을 사람들과 함께 식사하는 것이라더니…. 정말: Juriring said it was a dream to share a meal with the people of Devesis... And now it's come true.
strings.그런데 저렇게 큰 프리링이 있는데, 어째서 사람들이 놀라지 않지?: But why isn't anyone surprised to see such a huge Priring?
strings.%s, 그게 말이죠. 탑에서 연구하는 마법사들 중에 워낙 괴짜가 많아 사: Well, %s, many of the mages researching in the tower are rather eccentric. We have our share of incidents.
So Juriring showing up doesn't seem like much of a fuss...
strings.파텔로 씨가 요리 보조용 골렘을 만들었다며 보여 준 적이 있는데, 폭주해: Patello once showed us a golem he'd built as a kitchen assistant. It went berserk and demolished the shop.
strings.그리고 또 파텔로 씨가 보석 가공 기계에 마력을 불어넣어 움직이게끔 만들: Then he enchanted a gem-cutting machine to run by itself. Gem fragments shot into the sky over Devesis and burst like fireworks.
Come to think of it, Patello also...
strings.왜 모든 사건 사고에 파텔로 아저씨가 있는 거야?: Why is Uncle Patello involved in every single disaster?
strings.하하하하. 이게 다 천재 마법사의 숙명 아니겠어? 사고는 나만 치지 않았: Hahaha! Such is the fate of a genius mage, isn't it? I'm not the only one who's caused trouble!
Honestly, Patello. You ought to reflect on your behavior.
Huh? Elliot? Elliot, it's been so long!
Hello... %s... So this is where you were.
Where have you been? You suddenly disappeared. I was worried.
strings.또 마수 서식지에 갔어요?: Did you go back to the magical beasts' habitat?
strings.%s, 아는 사이군요. 만나서 반가워요. 저는 마르타, 데베시스의 촌장: An acquaintance of yours, %s? Pleased to meet you. I'm Marta, something of a village chief here in Devesis.
Wow... You're so pretty... My name's Shuvie.
N-no, I'm not. You're prettier, Sh-Shuvie.
strings.저기… 린포드로 가는 길이 사라진 것 같은데… 혹시 아시나요…?: Um... The road to Linford seems to have disappeared... Do you know anything about it...?
I couldn't find the road from Whispering Hill...
strings.잠깐, 린포드라고 했어? 그 천계의 조각 중 하나라는?: Wait. Did you say Linford? One of the fragments of the Celestial Realm?
strings.파텔로와 마르타 님은 왜 놀라시죠?: Why are you and Patello so surprised, Marta?
Oh, I know that Linford! Ring! The place that was cursed ten years ago...
